description:
Smelting time, wood burned and charcoal made. The smelting calculator page's math: `time`/`seconds` to smelt everything, `outputs` (metal fragments,
sulfur, HQM, low grade fuel), `wood_burned` and `charcoal_made` (about 0.75 per wood), `power_draw` for the
electric furnace, and `fits_one_fill` (false = you'll need to refill it). Ore a smelter can't process is
listed in `not_smeltable_here`. Server-default speeds; modded servers differ.

count.description: How many of that smelter share the ore.

crude_oil.description: Crude oil to refine (small oil refinery only).

hqm_ore.description: High quality metal ore to smelt.
